universe.selection_rule: Complete fixed issuer list from reconciled Q218 independent PIT reproduction; no outcome-based substitution.

event_pair_rules.ten_k: as-filed non-amended Form 10-K in the fixed independent PIT population
event_pair_rules.voluntary: non-amended Form 8-K with Item 2.02; Exhibit 99.1/generic earnings markers are diagnostics only
event_pair_rules.amendment_rule: Amended filings are excluded from the voluntary population; parent/amendment lineage is retained only as provenance.
event_pair_rules.future_data: Any SEC document, market observation or metadata timestamp after 2026-10-05T23:59:59Z is rejected.

feature_construction.document_scope: Primary document text from the exact paired filings only; no later documents.
feature_construction.html_normalization: Decode entities; remove script/style nodes; collapse whitespace; preserve textual order.
feature_construction.tokenization: UTF-8 lowercase ASCII-alphanumeric tokens matching [a-z0-9]+; no fitted vocabulary and no learned stopword list.
feature_construction.topic_representation: Deterministic 64-bucket SHA-256 token hashing; bucket = first 8 hex digits modulo 64.
feature_construction.unigram_presence: Binary presence of hashed unigram buckets.
feature_construction.bigram_frequency: L1-normalized hashed adjacent-token bigram frequencies using SHA-256(pair) modulo 64.

features.omission_asymmetry_by_topic: mean absolute difference of the 64 L1-normalized unigram-frequency buckets
features.secondary_framing_gap: 1 - cosine similarity of the 64 L1-normalized bigram-frequency buckets

outcome_contract.action_session: first XNYS trading session strictly after pair_closure_clock
outcome_contract.direction: signed two-sided; no ex-ante sign assumption
outcome_contract.price_source: frozen daily OHLCV snapshot acquired before performance execution
outcome_contract.missingness: Any missing action-session open/close is DATA_INSUFFICIENT; no imputation.

replication_contract.universe_rule: Complete fixed issuer list; all eligible event pairs in the same fixed window are used without outcome-based filtering.
